@dev Contract module that allows children to implement role-based access
 control mechanisms. This is a lightweight version that doesn't allow enumerating role
 members except through off-chain means by accessing the contract event logs. Some
 applications may benefit from on-chain enumerability, for those cases see
 {AccessControlEnumerable}.
 Roles are referred to by their `bytes32` identifier. These should be exposed
 in the external API and be unique. The best way to achieve this is by
 using `public constant` hash digests:
 ```solidity
 bytes32 public constant MY_ROLE = keccak256("MY_ROLE");
 ```
 Roles can be used to represent a set of permissions. To restrict access to a
 function call, use {hasRole}:
 ```solidity
 function foo() public {
     require(hasRole(MY_ROLE, msg.sender));
     ...
 }
 ```
 Roles can be granted and revoked dynamically via the {grantRole} and
 {revokeRole} functions. Each role has an associated admin role, and only
 accounts that have a role's admin role can call {grantRole} and {revokeRole}.
 By default, the admin role for all roles is `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`, which means
 that only accounts with this role will be able to grant or revoke other
 roles. More complex role relationships can be created by using
 {_setRoleAdmin}.
 WARNING: The `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is also its own admin: it has permission to
 grant and revoke this role. Extra precautions should be taken to secure
 accounts that have been granted it. We recommend using {AccessControlDefaultAdminRules}
 to enforce additional security measures for this role.

@dev Contract module which provides a basic access control mechanism, where
 there is an account (an owner) that can be granted exclusive access to
 specific functions.
 The initial owner is set to the address provided by the deployer. This can
 later be changed with {transferOwnership}.
 This module is used through inheritance. It will make available the modifier
 `onlyOwner`, which can be applied to your functions to restrict their use to
 the owner.

@dev Returns the address that signed a hashed message (`hash`) with `signature` or an error. This will not
 return address(0) without also returning an error description. Errors are documented using an enum (error type)
 and a bytes32 providing additional information about the error.
 If no error is returned, then the address can be used for verification purposes.
 The `ecrecover` EVM precompile allows for malleable (non-unique) signatures:
 this function rejects them by requiring the `s` value to be in the lower
 half order, and the `v` value to be either 27 or 28.
 IMPORTANT: `hash` _must_ be the result of a hash operation for the
 verification to be secure: it is possible to craft signatures that
 recover to arbitrary addresses for non-hashed data. A safe way to ensure
 this is by receiving a hash of the original message (which may otherwise
 be too long), and then calling {MessageHashUtils-toEthSignedMessageHash} on it.
 Documentation for signature generation:
 - with https://web3js.readthedocs.io/en/v1.3.4/web3-eth-accounts.html#sign[Web3.js]
 - with https://docs.ethers.io/v5/api/signer/#Signer-signMessage[ethers]

@dev https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-712[EIP-712] is a standard for hashing and signing of typed structured data.
 The encoding scheme specified in the EIP requires a domain separator and a hash of the typed structured data, whose
 encoding is very generic and therefore its implementation in Solidity is not feasible, thus this contract
 does not implement the encoding itself. Protocols need to implement the type-specific encoding they need in order to
 produce the hash of their typed data using a combination of `abi.encode` and `keccak256`.
 This contract implements the EIP-712 domain separator ({_domainSeparatorV4}) that is used as part of the encoding
 scheme, and the final step of the encoding to obtain the message digest that is then signed via ECDSA
 ({_hashTypedDataV4}).
 The implementation of the domain separator was designed to be as efficient as possible while still properly updating
 the chain id to protect against replay attacks on an eventual fork of the chain.
 NOTE: This contract implements the version of the encoding known as "v4", as implemented by the JSON RPC method
 https://docs.metamask.io/guide/signing-data.html[`eth_signTypedDataV4` in MetaMask].
 NOTE: In the upgradeable version of this contract, the cached values will correspond to the address, and the domain
 separator of the implementation contract. This will cause the {_domainSeparatorV4} function to always rebuild the
 separator from the immutable values, which is cheaper than accessing a cached version in cold storage.
 @custom:oz-upgrades-unsafe-allow state-variable-immutable

@dev Initializes the domain separator and parameter caches.
 The meaning of `name` and `version` is specified in

 - `name`: the user readable name of the signing domain, i.e. the name of the DApp or the protocol.
 - `version`: the current major version of the signing domain.
 NOTE: These parameters cannot be changed except through a xref:learn::upgrading-smart-contracts.adoc[smart
 contract upgrade].

@dev Signature message hash utilities for producing digests to be consumed by {ECDSA} recovery or signing.
 The library provides methods for generating a hash of a message that conforms to the
 https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-191[ERC-191] and https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-712[EIP 712]
 specifications.

@dev Returns the keccak256 digest of an ERC-191 signed data with version
 `0x45` (`personal_sign` messages).
 The digest is calculated by prefixing a bytes32 `messageHash` with
 `"\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n32"` and hashing the result. It corresponds with the
 hash signed when using the https://ethereum.org/en/developers/docs/apis/json-rpc/#eth_sign[`eth_sign`] JSON-RPC method.
 NOTE: The `messageHash` parameter is intended to be the result of hashing a raw message with
 keccak256, although any bytes32 value can be safely used because the final digest will
 be re-hashed.
 See {ECDSA-recover}.

@dev Returns the keccak256 digest of an ERC-191 signed data with version

 `"\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n" + len(message)` and hashing the result. It corresponds with the
 hash signed when using the https://ethereum.org/en/developers/docs/apis/json-rpc/#eth_sign[`eth_sign`] JSON-RPC method.
 See {ECDSA-recover}.

@dev Returns the keccak256 digest of an ERC-191 signed data with version

 See {ECDSA-recover}.

@dev Calculate the modular multiplicative inverse of a number in Z/nZ.
 If n is a prime, then Z/nZ is a field. In that case all elements are inversible, except 0.
 If n is not a prime, then Z/nZ is not a field, and some elements might not be inversible.
 If the input value is not inversible, 0 is returned.
 NOTE: If you know for sure that n is (big) a prime, it may be cheaper to use Fermat's little theorem and get the
 inverse using `Math.modExp(a, n - 2, n)`. See {invModPrime}.

@dev Variant of {invMod}. More efficient, but only works if `p` is known to be a prime greater than `2`.
 From https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fermat%27s_little_theorem[Fermat's little theorem], we know that if p is
 prime, then `a**(p-1) ≡ 1 mod p`. As a consequence, we have `a * a**(p-2) ≡ 1 mod p`, which means that
 `a**(p-2)` is the modular multiplicative inverse of a in Fp.
 NOTE: this function does NOT check that `p` is a prime greater than `2`.

@dev Returns the modular exponentiation of the specified base, exponent and modulus (b ** e % m)
 Requirements:
 - modulus can't be zero
 - underlying staticcall to precompile must succeed
 IMPORTANT: The result is only valid if the underlying call succeeds. When using this function, make
 sure the chain you're using it on supports the precompiled contract for modular exponentiation
 at address 0x05 as specified in https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-198[EIP-198]. Otherwise,
 the underlying function will succeed given the lack of a revert, but the result may be incorrectly
 interpreted as 0.

@dev Wrappers over Solidity's uintXX/intXX/bool casting operators with added overflow
 checks.
 Downcasting from uint256/int256 in Solidity does not revert on overflow. This can
 easily result in undesired exploitation or bugs, since developers usually
 assume that overflows raise errors. `SafeCast` restores this intuition by
 reverting the transaction when such an operation overflows.
 Using this library instead of the unchecked operations eliminates an entire
 class of bugs, so it's recommended to use it always.

@dev Parses the JSON string `s`, and returns the root.
 Reverts if `s` is not a valid JSON as specified in RFC 8259.
 Object items WILL simply contain all their children, inclusive of repeated keys,
 in the same order which they appear in the JSON string.
 Note: For efficiency, this function WILL NOT make a copy of `s`.
 The parsed tree WILL contain offsets to `s`.
 Do NOT pass in a string that WILL be modified later on.

@dev Returns the string value of the item.
 This is its exact string representation in the original JSON string.
 The returned string WILL have leading and trailing whitespace trimmed.
 All inner whitespace WILL be preserved, exactly as it is in the original JSON string.
 If the item's type is string, the returned string WILL be double-quoted, JSON encoded.
 Note: This function lazily instantiates and caches the returned string.
 Do NOT modify the returned string.

@dev Returns the index of the item in the array.
 It the item's parent is not an array, returns 0.

@dev Returns the key of the item in the object.
 It the item's parent is not an object, returns an empty string.
 The returned string WILL be double-quoted, JSON encoded.
 Note: This function lazily instantiates and caches the returned string.
 Do NOT modify the returned string.

@dev Returns the key of the item in the object.
 It the item is neither an array nor object, returns an empty array.
 Note: This function lazily instantiates and caches the returned array.
 Do NOT modify the returned array.

@dev Returns the number of children.

^0.8.24;\n\n/// @title IHub\n/// @author Relay Protocol\n/// @notice Interface for the Hub contract\ninterface IHub {\n  /// @notice Returns the balance of a token for an owner\n  /// @param owner The owner address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @return The balance amount\n  function balanceOf(address owner, uint256 id) external view returns (uint256);\n\n  /// @notice Transfers tokens from one address to another\n  /// @param sender The sender address\n  /// @param receiver The receiver address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param amount The amount to transfer\n  /// @return True if successful\n  function transferFrom(\n    address sender,\n    address receiver,\n    uint256 id,\n    uint256 amount\n  ) external returns (bool);\n\n  /// @notice Returns the total supply of a token\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @return The total supply\n  function totalSupply(uint256 id) external view returns (uint256);\n\n  /// @notice Returns the name of a token\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @return The token name\n  function name(uint256 id) external view returns (string memory);\n\n  /// @notice Returns the symbol of a token\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @return The token symbol\n  function symbol(uint256 id) external view returns (string memory);\n\n  /// @notice Returns the decimals of a token\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @return The token decimals\n  function decimals(uint256 id) external view returns (uint8);\n\n  /// @notice Returns the token URI of a token\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @return The token URI\n  function tokenURI(uint256 id) external view returns (string memory);\n\n  /// @notice Returns the allowance of a spender for an owner\n  /// @param owner The owner address\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @return The allowance amount\n  function allowance(\n    address owner,\n    address spender,\n    uint256 id\n  ) external view returns (uint256);\n\n  /// @notice Approves a spender to spend tokens on behalf of owner\n  /// @param owner The owner address\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param amount The amount to approve\n  /// @return True if successful\n  function approveFor(\n    address owner,\n    address spender,\n    uint256 id,\n    uint256 amount\n  ) external returns (bool);\n}\n\n/// @title ERC20View\n/// @author Relay Protocol\n/// @notice ERC20-compatible view contract that interfaces with the Hub\ncontract ERC20View {\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                EVENTS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Emitted when an approval is made\n  event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);\n  /// @notice Emitted when a transfer occurs\n  event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                            CUSTOM ERRORS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  error ERC20ViewInsufficientAllowance(\n    address spender,\n    uint256 allowance,\n    uint256 needed\n  );\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                STORAGE\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice The Hub contract instance\n  IHub public immutable hub;\n  /// @notice The token ID this view represents\n  uint256 public immutable tokenId;\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                              CONSTRUCTOR\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Constructor for ERC20View\n  /// @param _tokenId The token ID this view represents\n  constructor(uint256 _tokenId) {\n    hub = IHub(msg.sender);\n    tokenId = _tokenId;\n  }\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                          ERC20 IMPLEMENTATION\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Returns the name of the token\n  /// @return The token name\n  function name() public view returns (string memory) {\n    return hub.name(tokenId);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Returns the symbol of the token\n  /// @return The token symbol\n  function symbol() public view returns (string memory) {\n    return hub.symbol(tokenId);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Returns the decimals of the token\n  /// @return The token decimals\n  function decimals() public view returns (uint8) {\n    return hub.decimals(tokenId);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Returns the token URI\n  /// @return The token URI\n  function tokenURI() public view returns (string memory) {\n    return hub.tokenURI(tokenId);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Returns the total supply of the token\n  /// @return The total supply\n  function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) {\n    return hub.totalSupply(tokenId);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Returns the balance of an account\n  /// @param account The account address\n  /// @return The balance amount\n  function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {\n    return hub.balanceOf(account, tokenId);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Returns the allowance amount for a spender\n  /// @param owner The owner address\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @return The allowance amount\n  function allowance(\n    address owner,\n    address spender\n  ) public view returns (uint256) {\n    return hub.allowance(owner, spender, tokenId);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Approves a spender to spend tokens\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @param value The amount to approve\n  /// @return True if successful\n  function approve(address spender, uint256 value) public returns (bool) {\n    bool success = hub.approveFor(msg.sender, spender, tokenId, value);\n    if (success) {\n      emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, value);\n    }\n    return success;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Transfers tokens to another address\n  /// @param to The recipient address\n  /// @param value The amount to transfer\n  /// @return True if successful\n  function transfer(address to, uint256 value) public returns (bool) {\n    bool success = hub.transferFrom(msg.sender, to, tokenId, value);\n    if (success) {\n      emit Transfer(msg.sender, to, value);\n    }\n    return success;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Transfers tokens from one address to another\n  /// @param from The sender address\n  /// @param to The recipient address\n  /// @param value The amount to transfer\n  /// @return True if successful\n  function transferFrom(\n    address from,\n    address to,\n    uint256 value\n  ) public returns (bool) {\n    // Check allowance unless the spender is the owner\n    if (msg.sender != from) {\n      uint256 currentAllowance = hub.allowance(from, msg.sender, tokenId);\n      if (currentAllowance < type(uint256).max) {\n        if (currentAllowance < value) {\n          revert ERC20ViewInsufficientAllowance(\n            msg.sender,\n            currentAllowance,\n            value\n          );\n        }\n        hub.approveFor(from, msg.sender, tokenId, currentAllowance - value);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Execute the transfer on the Hub\n    bool success = hub.transferFrom(from, to, tokenId, value);\n    if (success) {\n      emit Transfer(from, to, value);\n    }\n    return success;\n  }\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                          HUB EVENT EMISSION\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Emits a transfer event (only callable by the hub)\n  /// @param from The sender address\n  /// @param to The recipient address\n  /// @param value The amount transferred\n  function emitTransferEvent(address from, address to, uint256 value) external {\n    if (msg.sender == address(hub)) {\n      emit Transfer(from, to, value);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Emits an approval event (only callable by the hub)\n  /// @param owner The owner address\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @param value The approved amount\n  function emitApprovalEvent(\n    address owner,\n    address spender,\n    uint256 value\n  ) external {\n    if (msg.sender == address(hub)) {\n      emit Approval(owner, spender, value);\n    }\n  }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xb7b82f3d5501154c68526fddbb556effc42f04e9c932d94040222a0680326fba","license":"MIT"},"contracts/RelayAllocator.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.28;\n\nimport {AccessControl} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport {EIP712} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/cryptography/EIP712.sol\";\nimport {ECDSA} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/cryptography/ECDSA.sol\";\nimport {\n  AuroraSdk,\n  NEAR,\n  PromiseCreateArgs,\n  PromiseResult,\n  PromiseResultStatus,\n  PromiseWithCallback\n} from \"./aurora-xcc/AuroraSdk.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {Strings} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Strings.sol\";\nimport {RelayHub} from \"./RelayHub.sol\";\nimport {Utils} from \"./Utils.sol\";\nimport {ChainSignatures} from \"./ChainSignatures.sol\";\n\n/// @title IEvmERC20\n/// @notice Interface for EVM ERC20 tokens that support withdrawal to NEAR\n// solhint-disable-next-line use-natspec\ninterface IEvmERC20 is IERC20 {\n  /// @notice Withdraws tokens to NEAR network\n  /// @param recipient The recipient address on NEAR\n  /// @param amount The amount to withdraw\n  function withdrawToNear(bytes memory recipient, uint256 amount) external;\n}\n\n/// @title ISafe\n/// @notice Interface for Safe multisig contract\n// solhint-disable-next-line use-natspec\ninterface ISafe {\n  /// @notice Checks if an address is an owner of the Safe\n  /// @param owner The address to check\n  /// @return True if the address is an owner\n  function isOwner(address owner) external view returns (bool);\n}\n\n/// @title IPayloadBuilder\n/// @author Relay Protocol\n/// @notice Interface for payload builders that create withdrawal payloads for different chains\ninterface IPayloadBuilder {\n  error InsufficientAmount(uint256 amount);\n\n  /// @notice Builds a withdrawal payload for the specified parameters\n  /// @param chainId The destination chain ID\n  /// @param depository The depository address\n  /// @param currency The currency address\n  /// @param amount The amount to withdraw\n  /// @param receiver The receiver address\n  /// @param data Additional data\n  /// @return The built payload\n  function buildPayload(\n    uint256 chainId,\n    string calldata depository,\n    string calldata currency,\n    uint256 amount,\n    string calldata receiver,\n    bytes calldata data\n  ) external view returns (bytes memory);\n\n  /// @notice Returns the hashes that need to be signed for the payload\n  /// @param chainId The destination chain ID\n  /// @param depository The depository address\n  /// @param payload The payload to sign\n  /// @return Array of hashes to sign\n  function hashToSign(\n    uint256 chainId,\n    string calldata depository,\n    bytes calldata payload,\n    uint32 hashIndex\n  ) external view returns (bytes32);\n\n  /// @notice Returns the curve used for signing\n  /// @return The curve name\n  function curve() external pure returns (string memory);\n\n  /// @notice Returns the family of the payload builder\n  /// @return The family name\n  function family() external pure returns (string memory);\n}\n\n// NEAR gas settings\nstruct GasSettings {\n  uint64 signGas;\n  uint64 callbackGas;\n}\n\n/// @title Allocator\n/// @author Relay Protocol\n/// @notice Manages cross-chain withdrawal requests and payload signing using NEAR MPC signer\ncontract RelayAllocator is AccessControl, Ownable, EIP712 {\n  using AuroraSdk for NEAR;\n  using AuroraSdk for PromiseCreateArgs;\n  using AuroraSdk for PromiseWithCallback;\n  using AuroraSdk for PromiseResult;\n  using Strings for uint256;\n  using ECDSA for bytes32;\n\n  /// @notice Emitted when the global delay is changed\n  event DelayChanged(uint256 delay);\n  /// @notice Emitted when a depository-specific delay is changed\n  event DepositoryDelayChanged(\n    uint256 chainId,\n    string depository,\n    uint256 delay\n  );\n  /// @notice Emitted when the hub contract is set\n  event HubSet(address hub);\n  /// @notice Emitted when the signature fee is changed\n  event SignatureFeeChanged(uint256 fee);\n\n  // EIP712\n  /// @notice The signing domain for EIP712\n  string public constant SIGNING_DOMAIN = \"RelayAllocator\";\n  /// @notice The signature version for EIP712\n  string public constant SIGNATURE_VERSION = \"1\";\n  /// @notice The type hash for SubmitWithdrawRequest\n  bytes32 public constant PAYLOAD_TYPEHASH =\n    keccak256(\n      \"SubmitWithdrawRequest(uint256 chainId,string depository,string currency,uint256 amount,address spender,string receiver,bytes data,bytes32 nonce)\"\n    );\n\n  // roles\n  /// @notice Role for approved withdrawers\n  bytes32 public constant APPROVED_WITHDRAWER_ROLE =\n    keccak256(\"APPROVED_WITHDRAWER_ROLE\");\n  /// @notice Role for administrators\n  bytes32 public constant ADMIN_ROLE = keccak256(\"ADMIN_ROLE\");\n\n  /// @notice Precompute the hash of the curve\n  bytes32 private constant ECDSA_HASH = keccak256(\"Ecdsa\");\n\n  /// @notice Gas for withdrawals to NEAR\n  uint64 public immutable NEAR_WITHDRAW_GAS = 2_000_000_000_000;\n\n  /// @notice The NEAR signer account address\n  string public nearSigner;\n\n  /// @notice The Aurora SDK NEAR instance\n  NEAR public near;\n\n  /// @notice Global delay for withdrawal requests\n  uint256 public delay;\n\n  /// @notice Path used by the MPC signer to sign the payload\n  string public signerPath;\n\n  /// @notice Fee in wNEAR to cover gas on NEAR\n  uint256 public signatureFee;\n\n  /// @notice Delay configuration struct\n  struct DelayConfig {\n    uint256 delay;\n    bool isSet;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Mapping of delays per-depository : chain ID => depository => delay\n  mapping(uint256 => mapping(string => DelayConfig)) public depositoryDelays;\n\n  /// @notice Address of the hub contract\n  address public hub;\n\n  /// @notice Mapping of payload builders: chain ID => depository => payload builder address\n  mapping(uint256 => mapping(string => address)) public payloadBuilders;\n\n  /// @notice Signed payloads: withdrawal request hash => hash to sign => signed payload\n  mapping(bytes32 => mapping(bytes32 => bytes)) public signedPayloads;\n\n  /// @notice Payload timestamps: withdrawal request hash => timestamp when payload becomes ready\n  mapping(bytes32 => uint256) public payloadTimestamps;\n\n  /// @notice Unsigned payloads: withdrawal request hash => payload\n  mapping(bytes32 => bytes) public payloads;\n\n  /// @notice Used nonces for replay protection: sender => nonce => whether it has been used\n  mapping(address => mapping(bytes32 => bool)) public usedNonces;\n\n  /// @notice Emitted when a payload builder is set for a chain and depository\n  event PayloadBuilderSet(\n    uint256 indexed chainId,\n    string indexed depository,\n    address indexed builder\n  );\n\n  /// @notice Emitted when a payload is built\n  event PayloadBuilt(\n    bytes32 indexed withdrawRequestHash,\n    bytes payload,\n    uint256 timestamp\n  );\n\n  /// @notice Emitted when a payload is signed\n  event PayloadWithdrawSigned(\n    bytes32 indexed withdrawRequestHash,\n    bytes32 indexed hashToSign,\n    bytes signedPayload\n  );\n\n  // errors\n  error NotMultisigOwner(address account);\n  error CallerIsNotApproved(address account);\n  error NoPayloadBuilder(uint256 chainId, string depository);\n  error PayloadNotReady(bytes32 withdrawRequestHash);\n  error PayloadAlreadyBuilt(bytes32 withdrawRequestHash);\n  error PayloadAlreadySigned(bytes32 withdrawRequestHash);\n  error SignCallbackFailed(bytes32 withdrawRequestHash);\n  error WithdrawalRequestFailed();\n\n  struct SubmitWithdrawRequest {\n    uint256 chainId; // ChainId of the destination chain on which the user will withdraw\n    string depository; // Address of the depository account as a string so we can support non EVM\n    string currency; // Address of the currency to be withdrawn, as a string so we can support non EVM. Use zero address for native.\n    uint256 amount; // Amount to withdraw\n    address spender; // Address of the account that owns the balance in the Hub contract (can be an alias)\n    string receiver; // Address of the account on the destination chain as a string so we can support non EVM\n    bytes data; // Additional data to be passed to the payload builder\n    bytes32 nonce; // Nonce for replay protection\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Constructor for RelayAllocator contract\n  /// @param _owner The owner of the contract\n  /// @param _delay The global delay for withdrawal requests\n  /// @param _signer The NEAR signer account\n  /// @param _wNEAR The wNEAR token address\n  constructor(\n    address _owner,\n    uint256 _delay,\n    string memory _signer,\n    address _wNEAR\n  ) Ownable(_owner) EIP712(SIGNING_DOMAIN, SIGNATURE_VERSION) {\n    // roles\n    _setRoleAdmin(APPROVED_WITHDRAWER_ROLE, ADMIN_ROLE);\n    _grantRole(ADMIN_ROLE, _owner);\n\n    // delay\n    delay = _delay;\n\n    // set signer and Aurora SDK\n    nearSigner = _signer;\n    near = AuroraSdk.initNear(IERC20(_wNEAR)); // this does an unlimited approval for wNEAR for the precompile.\n\n    // compute path at deployment\n    signerPath = Strings.toHexString(uint160(address(this)), 20);\n\n    // Fee - default to 0\n    signatureFee = 0;\n  }\n\n  modifier onlyMultisigOwner() {\n    if (!ISafe(owner()).isOwner(msg.sender))\n      revert NotMultisigOwner(msg.sender);\n    _;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice initializes XCC sub-account for the contract\n  /// You need to approve 2 wNEAR for the CS Signer to init the sub-account\n  /// @notice This calls the simplest possible contract on NEAR to bootstrap itself and initialize the XCC subaccount.\n  function init() public onlyOwner {\n    // this will initialize the XCC sub-account on NEAR\n    // 2 Near are required for storage staking\n    near.wNEAR.transferFrom(\n      msg.sender,\n      address(this),\n      uint256(2_000_000_000_000_000_000_000_000)\n    );\n\n    // Make a cross-contract call to trigger sub-account creation.\n    // we are calling the \"system\" account with empty data on NEAR to trigger sub-account creation\n    // as \"system\" is a special account that is not part of the chain state.\n    PromiseCreateArgs memory initCall = near.call(\n      \"system\",\n      \"\",\n      \"\",\n      0,\n      500_000_000_000\n    );\n    initCall.transact();\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Grants a role to an address\n  /// @param role The role to grant\n  /// @param newOwner The address to grant the role to\n  function grantRole(bytes32 role, address newOwner) public override onlyOwner {\n    _grantRole(role, newOwner);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Revokes a role from an address\n  /// @param role The role to revoke\n  /// @param newOwner The address to revoke the role from\n  function revokeRole(\n    bytes32 role,\n    address newOwner\n  ) public override onlyOwner {\n    _revokeRole(role, newOwner);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice prevents a withdrawer from withdrawing\n  /// @param withdrawer Address to prevent from withdrawing\n  function suspend(address withdrawer) public onlyMultisigOwner {\n    _revokeRole(APPROVED_WITHDRAWER_ROLE, withdrawer);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Sets the hub contract address\n  /// @param _fee Signature fee in wNEAR\n  function setSignatureFee(uint256 _fee) external onlyOwner {\n    signatureFee = _fee;\n    emit SignatureFeeChanged(signatureFee);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Sets the hub contract address\n  /// @param _hub Hub contract address\n  function setHub(address _hub) external onlyOwner {\n    hub = _hub;\n    emit HubSet(hub);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Sets the global delay for withdrawal requests\n  /// @param _delay Delay in seconds\n  function setDelay(uint256 _delay) public onlyOwner {\n    delay = _delay;\n    emit DelayChanged(delay);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice sets or updates the delay for a specific chain and depository\n  /// @param chainId chain ID\n  /// @param depository address of the depository contract as string\n  /// @param _delay delay in seconds\n  function setDepositoryDelay(\n    uint256 chainId,\n    string calldata depository,\n    uint256 _delay\n  ) external onlyOwner {\n    depositoryDelays[chainId][depository].delay = _delay;\n    depositoryDelays[chainId][depository].isSet = true;\n    emit DepositoryDelayChanged(chainId, depository, _delay);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice sets or updates the payload builder for a specific chain\n  /// @param chainId chain ID\n  /// @param builder address of the payload builder contract\n  function setPayloadBuilder(\n    uint256 chainId,\n    string calldata depository,\n    address builder\n  ) external onlyOwner {\n    payloadBuilders[chainId][depository] = builder;\n    emit PayloadBuilderSet(chainId, depository, builder);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice submits a withdraw request to the payload builder, stores the returned payload, and triggers its signature immediately. This will only work for payloads that require a single signature (including Bitcoin, which is now supported via the hashIndex parameter).\n  /// @param params The withdraw request parameters\n  /// @param signature The signature of the withdraw request, if sent on behalf of a recipient\n  function submitAndSignWithdrawRequest(\n    SubmitWithdrawRequest calldata params,\n    bytes memory signature,\n    GasSettings memory gasSettings\n  ) public {\n    _submitWithdrawRequest(params);\n    signWithdrawPayloadHash(params, signature, gasSettings, 0);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice submits a withdraw request to the payload builder, store the returned payload\n  /// @param params The withdraw request parameters\n  /// @return withdrawRequestHash The hash of the withdrawal request\n  function submitWithdrawRequest(\n    SubmitWithdrawRequest calldata params\n  ) public returns (bytes32 withdrawRequestHash) {\n    return _submitWithdrawRequest(params);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice submits a withdraw request to the payload builder, store the returned payload\n  /// @param params The withdraw request parameters\n  /// @return withdrawRequestHash The hash of the withdrawal request\n  function _submitWithdrawRequest(\n    SubmitWithdrawRequest calldata params\n  ) internal returns (bytes32 withdrawRequestHash) {\n    // check if the payload builder is set\n    address builder = payloadBuilders[params.chainId][params.depository];\n\n    if (builder == address(0)) {\n      revert NoPayloadBuilder(params.chainId, params.depository);\n    }\n\n    // build payload\n    bytes memory payload = IPayloadBuilder(builder).buildPayload(\n      params.chainId,\n      params.depository,\n      params.currency,\n      params.amount,\n      params.receiver,\n      params.data\n    );\n\n    // Store the hash of the request for deduplication and verification\n    withdrawRequestHash = keccak256(abi.encode(params));\n    payloads[withdrawRequestHash] = payload;\n\n    // Use depository-specific delay if set, otherwise fall back to global delay\n    uint256 depositoryDelay = depositoryDelays[params.chainId][\n      params.depository\n    ].delay;\n    uint256 effectiveDelay = depositoryDelays[params.chainId][params.depository]\n      .isSet\n      ? depositoryDelay\n      : delay;\n\n    // Only set timestamp if it hasn't been set before to prevent timestamp manipulation\n    if (payloadTimestamps[withdrawRequestHash] != 0) {\n      revert PayloadAlreadyBuilt(withdrawRequestHash);\n    }\n\n    payloadTimestamps[withdrawRequestHash] = block.timestamp + effectiveDelay;\n\n    emit PayloadBuilt(\n      withdrawRequestHash,\n      payload,\n      payloadTimestamps[withdrawRequestHash]\n    );\n    return withdrawRequestHash;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice triggers the signing of a previously submitted withdraw request\n  /// @param params The withdraw request parameters (must match the stored hash)\n  /// @param signature The signature of the withdraw request, if sent on behalf of a recipient\n  /// @param gasSettings struct containing gas settings for NEAR operations\n  /// @param hashIndex index of the hash to sign for this request\n  /// @dev This function is called by the NEAR signer account to sign the payload.\n  /// It checks if the payload is ready to be signed (i.e. the delay has passed) and\n  /// if the payload has not already been signed. If the payload is ready, it calls\n  /// the NEAR signer account to sign the payload and then calls the signWithdrawCallback\n  /// function to handle the result of the signing.\n  function signWithdrawPayloadHash(\n    SubmitWithdrawRequest calldata params,\n    bytes memory signature,\n    GasSettings memory gasSettings,\n    uint32 hashIndex\n  ) public {\n    if (signatureFee > 0) {\n      // We capture the fee for ourselves first\n      near.wNEAR.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), signatureFee);\n    }\n\n    bytes32 withdrawRequestHash = keccak256(abi.encode(params));\n\n    // make sure the payload exists\n    bytes memory payload = payloads[withdrawRequestHash];\n    if (payload.length == 0) {\n      revert PayloadNotReady(withdrawRequestHash);\n    }\n\n    // check if the payload is ready to be signed\n    if (payloadTimestamps[withdrawRequestHash] > block.timestamp) {\n      revert PayloadNotReady(withdrawRequestHash);\n    }\n\n    address builder = payloadBuilders[params.chainId][params.depository];\n    IPayloadBuilder payloadBuilder = IPayloadBuilder(builder);\n\n    // verify the withdrawal can be achieved\n    verifyWithdrawal(params, payloadBuilder, signature);\n\n    // get the hash to sign\n    bytes32 hashToSign = payloadBuilder.hashToSign(\n      params.chainId,\n      params.depository,\n      payload,\n      hashIndex\n    );\n\n    _signUsingChainSignatures(\n      withdrawRequestHash,\n      hashToSign,\n      payloadBuilder,\n      gasSettings\n    );\n  }\n\n  /// @notice withdraws the wNEAR balance of this contract\n  /// from the Aurora contract to the NEAR network\n  function withdrawToNear(uint256 amount) external {\n    // withdraw wNEAR to the NEAR network\n    IEvmERC20(address(near.wNEAR)).withdrawToNear(\n      bytes(AuroraSdk.nearRepresentative(address(this))),\n      amount\n    );\n\n    // unwrap the wNEAR on the NEAR network\n    PromiseCreateArgs memory unwrapCall = near.call(\n      \"wrap.testnet\",\n      \"near_withdraw\",\n      abi.encodePacked(\n        // solhint-disable-next-line quotes\n        '{\"amount\": \"',\n        Strings.toString(amount),\n        // solhint-disable-next-line quotes\n        '\"}'\n      ),\n      1, // requires attached deposit of exactly 1 yoctoNEAR\n      NEAR_WITHDRAW_GAS // nearGas\n    );\n\n    unwrapCall.transact();\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Signs a hash using chain signatures\n  /// @param withdrawRequestHash The withdrawal request hash\n  /// @param hashToSign The hash to sign\n  /// @param payloadBuilder The payload builder\n  /// @param gasSettings The gas settings for NEAR operations\n  function _signUsingChainSignatures(\n    bytes32 withdrawRequestHash,\n    bytes32 hashToSign,\n    IPayloadBuilder payloadBuilder,\n    GasSettings memory gasSettings\n  ) internal {\n    if (signedPayloads[withdrawRequestHash][hashToSign].length > 0) {\n      revert PayloadAlreadySigned(withdrawRequestHash);\n    }\n    // Encode the JSON request for the signer\n    bytes memory data = ChainSignatures.encodeJSONRequest(\n      ChainSignatures.stringifyBytes(abi.encodePacked(hashToSign)),\n      payloadBuilder.curve(),\n      signerPath,\n      keccak256(abi.encodePacked(payloadBuilder.curve())) == ECDSA_HASH\n        ? \"0\"\n        : \"1\"\n    );\n    // Now get NEAR to sign the payload!\n    PromiseCreateArgs memory callSign = near.call(\n      nearSigner,\n      \"sign\",\n      data,\n      // the docs here https://github.com/aurora-is-near/chain-signatures-signer/tree/main?tab=readme-ov-file#signing-the-payload\n      // states that 1 yoctoNEAR is usually enough to sign the call successfully\n      1, // attachedNear\n      gasSettings.signGas\n    );\n    PromiseCreateArgs memory callback = near.auroraCall(\n      address(this),\n      abi.encodeWithSelector(\n        this.signWithdrawCallback.selector,\n        withdrawRequestHash,\n        hashToSign\n      ),\n      0,\n      gasSettings.callbackGas\n    );\n    callSign.then(callback).transact();\n  }\n\n  /// @notice callback function to handle the result of the signing\n  /// @param withdrawRequestHash hash of the requested withdrawal payload that was signed\n  /// @dev This function is called by the NEAR signer account after the signing is complete.\n  /// It checks if the signing was successful and if so, stores the signed payload in the\n  /// signedPayloads mapping. It also emits an event to notify that the payload has been signed.\n  function signWithdrawCallback(\n    bytes32 withdrawRequestHash,\n    bytes32 hashToSign\n  ) public {\n    if (\n      msg.sender != AuroraSdk.nearRepresentitiveImplicitAddress(address(this))\n    ) {\n      revert AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount(\n        msg.sender,\n        keccak256(\"SIGNATURE_CALLBACK_ROLE\")\n      );\n    }\n    // triggering this function requires Aurora precompiles and therefore has no unit tests\n    PromiseResult memory result = AuroraSdk.promiseResult(0);\n\n    if (result.status != PromiseResultStatus.Successful) {\n      revert SignCallbackFailed(withdrawRequestHash);\n    }\n\n    signedPayloads[withdrawRequestHash][hashToSign] = result.output;\n    emit PayloadWithdrawSigned(withdrawRequestHash, hashToSign, result.output);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Verifies if the withdrawal request can be achieved.\n  /// @dev The withdrawal can be achieved if the caller is an approved withdrawer, or,\n  /// if the hub is set, it will first transfer the user's token to this contract's balance.\n  /// @param params The withdrawal request parameters\n  /// @param payloadBuilder The payload builder containing the withdrawal details\n  /// @param signature A signature for the withdrawal request, if sent on behalf of a recipient\n  function verifyWithdrawal(\n    SubmitWithdrawRequest calldata params,\n    IPayloadBuilder payloadBuilder,\n    bytes memory signature\n  ) internal {\n    // Implementation for verifying the withdrawal\n    if (hasRole(APPROVED_WITHDRAWER_ROLE, msg.sender)) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    string memory family = payloadBuilder.family();\n\n    // Generate the tokenId\n    uint256 tokenId = Utils.generateTokenId(\n      family,\n      params.chainId,\n      params.currency\n    );\n\n    address spenderAlias = Utils.generateAddress(\n      family,\n      params.chainId,\n      params.receiver\n    );\n\n    // Only an operator for the spender can trigger withdrawals or a valid signature by the recipient must be provided.\n    if (\n      !(params.spender == msg.sender ||\n        RelayHub(hub).isOperator(params.spender, msg.sender) ||\n        (spenderAlias == params.spender &&\n          signatureMatchesReceiver(params, signature)))\n    ) {\n      revert CallerIsNotApproved(msg.sender);\n    }\n\n    // Actually perform the transfer\n    RelayHub(hub).transferFrom(\n      params.spender,\n      address(this),\n      tokenId,\n      params.amount\n    );\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Checks if the signature matches the receiver's address (for EVM destination chains)\n  /// @param params The withdrawal request parameters\n  /// @param signature The signature to verify\n  /// @return True if the signature matches the receiver\n  function signatureMatchesReceiver(\n    SubmitWithdrawRequest memory params,\n    bytes memory signature\n  ) internal returns (bool) {\n    if (signature.length == 0) return false;\n\n    address signer = Utils.toAddress(params.receiver);\n\n    // Check if nonce has been used before for this sender\n    if (usedNonces[signer][params.nonce]) {\n      return false;\n    }\n\n    // Create the digest using EIP712\n    bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(\n      keccak256(\n        abi.encode(\n          PAYLOAD_TYPEHASH,\n          params.chainId,\n          keccak256(bytes(params.depository)),\n          keccak256(bytes(params.currency)),\n          params.amount,\n          params.spender,\n          keccak256(bytes(params.receiver)),\n          keccak256(params.data),\n          params.nonce\n        )\n      )\n    );\n\n    if (digest.recover(signature) != signer) {\n      return false;\n    }\n\n    // Mark nonce as used to prevent replay for this sender\n    usedNonces[signer][params.nonce] = true;\n    return true;\n  }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xb07d8e7b3f659141e929a9afd820b4fdf76d14ec67649c786f0980ce2bed7c4d","license":"MIT"},"contracts/RelayHub.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.24;\n\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Strings.sol\";\nimport {AccessControl} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Strings.sol\";\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/cryptography/EIP712.sol\";\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/cryptography/ECDSA.sol\";\nimport \"./ERC20View.sol\";\n\n/// @title IERC20View\n/// @author Relay Protocol\n/// @notice Interface for ERC20View contract\ninterface IERC20View {\n  /// @notice Emits a transfer event\n  /// @param from The sender address\n  /// @param to The recipient address\n  /// @param value The amount transferred\n  function emitTransferEvent(address from, address to, uint256 value) external;\n\n  /// @notice Emits an approval event\n  /// @param owner The owner address\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @param value The approved amount\n  function emitApprovalEvent(\n    address owner,\n    address spender,\n    uint256 value\n  ) external;\n}\n\n/// @title RelayHub\n/// @author Relay Protocol\n/// @notice Based on Solmate standard ERC6909 implementation. (https://github.com/transmissions11/solmate/blob/main/src/tokens/ERC6909.sol)\ncontract RelayHub is AccessControl, EIP712 {\n  using Strings for uint256;\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                            CUSTOM ERRORS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Error thrown when non-ERC20View tries to call approveFor\n  /// @param caller The address that attempted to call approveFor\n  /// @param expectedERC20View The expected ERC20View address for the token\n  error OnlyERC20ViewCanCallApproveFor(\n    address caller,\n    address expectedERC20View\n  );\n\n  /// @notice Error thrown when permit deadline has expired\n  error PermitDeadlineExpired();\n\n  /// @notice Error thrown when permit signature is invalid\n  error InvalidPermitSignature();\n\n  /// @notice Error thrown when permit owner is the zero address\n  error InvalidPermitOwner();\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                 EVENTS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Emitted when an operator is set for an owner\n  event OperatorSet(\n    address indexed owner,\n    address indexed operator,\n    bool approved\n  );\n\n  /// @notice Emitted when an approval is made\n  event Approval(\n    address indexed owner,\n    address indexed spender,\n    uint256 indexed id,\n    uint256 amount\n  );\n\n  /// @notice Emitted when a transfer occurs\n  event Transfer(\n    address caller,\n    address indexed from,\n    address indexed to,\n    uint256 indexed id,\n    uint256 amount\n  );\n\n  struct TokenMetadata {\n    string name;\n    string symbol;\n    uint8 decimals;\n    string originFamily;\n    uint256 originChainId;\n    string originAsset;\n  }\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                             ERC6909 STORAGE\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) internal _isOperator;\n\n  /// @notice Mapping of owner to token ID to balance\n  mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) public balanceOf;\n\n  /// @notice Mapping of owner to spender to token ID to allowance\n  mapping(address => mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256)))\n    public allowance;\n\n  /// @notice Mapping of token ID to total supply\n  mapping(uint256 => uint256) public totalSupply;\n\n  /// @notice Mapping of owner to nonce for permit signatures\n  mapping(address => uint256) public nonces;\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                          ERC20VIEW STORAGE\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  // tokenId => ERC20View address\n  /// @notice Mapping of token ID to ERC20View contract address\n  mapping(uint256 => address) public erc20Views;\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                        ERC20VIEW EVENTS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Emitted when an ERC20View is created\n  event ERC20ViewCreated(uint256 indexed tokenId, address indexed erc20View);\n  /// @notice Mapping of token ID to token metadata\n  mapping(uint256 => TokenMetadata) public tokenMetadata;\n\n  /// @notice Contract URI for metadata\n  string public contractURI = \"\";\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                             ROLES\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Role for operators\n  bytes32 public constant OPERATOR_ROLE = keccak256(\"OPERATOR_ROLE\");\n  /// @notice Role for editors\n  bytes32 public constant EDITOR_ROLE = keccak256(\"EDITOR_ROLE\");\n  /// @notice Role for administrators\n  bytes32 public constant ADMIN_ROLE = keccak256(\"ADMIN_ROLE\");\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                          EIP712 CONSTANTS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice EIP712 typehash for permit\n  bytes32 public constant PERMIT_TYPEHASH =\n    keccak256(\n      \"Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 tokenId,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)\"\n    );\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                             CONSTRUCTOR\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Constructor for RelayHub contract\n  /// @param adminAddress The address to grant admin role\n  constructor(address adminAddress) EIP712(\"RelayHub\", \"1\") {\n    _setRoleAdmin(OPERATOR_ROLE, ADMIN_ROLE);\n    _setRoleAdmin(EDITOR_ROLE, ADMIN_ROLE);\n    _setRoleAdmin(ADMIN_ROLE, ADMIN_ROLE);\n    _grantRole(ADMIN_ROLE, adminAddress);\n  }\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                              ERC6909 LOGIC\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Checks if an address is an operator for an account\n  /// @param account The account address\n  /// @param operator The operator address\n  /// @return True if the operator is authorized\n  function isOperator(\n    address account,\n    address operator\n  ) public view returns (bool) {\n    return hasRole(OPERATOR_ROLE, operator) || _isOperator[account][operator];\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Internal function to set an operator for an account\n  /// @param account The account address\n  /// @param operator The operator address\n  /// @param approved Whether to approve the operator\n  /// @return result True if successful\n  function _setOperatorFor(\n    address account,\n    address operator,\n    bool approved\n  ) internal returns (bool result) {\n    _isOperator[account][operator] = approved;\n    emit OperatorSet(account, operator, approved);\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Sets an operator for an account (only callable by OPERATOR_ROLE)\n  /// @param account The account address\n  /// @param operator The operator address\n  /// @param approved Whether to approve the operator\n  /// @return result True if successful\n  function setOperatorFor(\n    address account,\n    address operator,\n    bool approved\n  ) public onlyRole(OPERATOR_ROLE) returns (bool result) {\n    return _setOperatorFor(account, operator, approved);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Sets an operator for the caller\n  /// @param operator The operator address\n  /// @param approved Whether to approve the operator\n  /// @return result True if successful\n  function setOperator(\n    address operator,\n    bool approved\n  ) public returns (bool result) {\n    return _setOperatorFor(msg.sender, operator, approved);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Transfers tokens to another address\n  /// @param receiver The recipient address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param amount The amount to transfer\n  /// @return result True if successful\n  function transfer(\n    address receiver,\n    uint256 id,\n    uint256 amount\n  ) public returns (bool result) {\n    balanceOf[msg.sender][id] -= amount;\n\n    balanceOf[receiver][id] += amount;\n\n    emit Transfer(msg.sender, msg.sender, receiver, id, amount);\n    _emitERC20ViewEvent(id, msg.sender, receiver, amount);\n\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Transfers tokens from one address to another\n  /// @param sender The sender address\n  /// @param receiver The recipient address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param amount The amount to transfer\n  /// @return result True if successful\n  function transferFrom(\n    address sender,\n    address receiver,\n    uint256 id,\n    uint256 amount\n  ) public returns (bool result) {\n    if (\n      msg.sender != sender &&\n      !isOperator(sender, msg.sender) &&\n      erc20Views[id] != msg.sender\n    ) {\n      uint256 allowed = allowance[sender][msg.sender][id];\n      if (allowed != type(uint256).max)\n        allowance[sender][msg.sender][id] = allowed - amount;\n    }\n\n    balanceOf[sender][id] -= amount;\n\n    balanceOf[receiver][id] += amount;\n\n    emit Transfer(msg.sender, sender, receiver, id, amount);\n    _emitERC20ViewEvent(id, sender, receiver, amount);\n\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Approves a spender to spend tokens\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param amount The amount to approve\n  /// @return result True if successful\n  function approve(\n    address spender,\n    uint256 id,\n    uint256 amount\n  ) public returns (bool result) {\n    allowance[msg.sender][spender][id] = amount;\n\n    emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, id, amount);\n    _emitERC20ViewApprovalEvent(id, msg.sender, spender, amount);\n\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Approves a spender to spend tokens on behalf of owner (only callable by ERC20View)\n  /// @param owner The owner address\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param amount The amount to approve\n  /// @return result True if successful\n  function approveFor(\n    address owner,\n    address spender,\n    uint256 id,\n    uint256 amount\n  ) public returns (bool result) {\n    if (erc20Views[id] != msg.sender) {\n      revert OnlyERC20ViewCanCallApproveFor(msg.sender, erc20Views[id]);\n    }\n\n    allowance[owner][spender][id] = amount;\n\n    emit Approval(owner, spender, id, amount);\n    // Note: The ERC20View will emit its own Approval event\n\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Permits a spender to spend tokens via signature (EIP712)\n  /// @param owner The owner address\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @param tokenId The token ID\n  /// @param value The allowance amount\n  /// @param deadline The deadline timestamp\n  /// @param v The recovery byte of the signature\n  /// @param r Half of the ECDSA signature pair\n  /// @param s Half of the ECDSA signature pair\n  function permit(\n    address owner,\n    address spender,\n    uint256 tokenId,\n    uint256 value,\n    uint256 deadline,\n    uint8 v,\n    bytes32 r,\n    bytes32 s\n  ) public {\n    if (owner == address(0)) {\n      revert InvalidPermitOwner();\n    }\n\n    if (block.timestamp > deadline) {\n      revert PermitDeadlineExpired();\n    }\n\n    uint256 ownerNonce = nonces[owner];\n\n    bytes32 structHash = keccak256(\n      abi.encode(\n        PERMIT_TYPEHASH,\n        owner,\n        spender,\n        tokenId,\n        value,\n        ownerNonce,\n        deadline\n      )\n    );\n\n    bytes32 hash = _hashTypedDataV4(structHash);\n\n    address signer = ECDSA.recover(hash, v, r, s);\n\n    if (signer != owner) {\n      revert InvalidPermitSignature();\n    }\n\n    nonces[owner] = ownerNonce + 1;\n\n    allowance[owner][spender][tokenId] = value;\n\n    emit Approval(owner, spender, tokenId, value);\n    _emitERC20ViewApprovalEvent(tokenId, owner, spender, value);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Mints tokens to a receiver (only callable by OPERATOR_ROLE)\n  /// @param receiver The recipient address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param amount The amount to mint\n  /// @return result True if successful\n  function mint(\n    address receiver,\n    uint256 id,\n    uint256 amount\n  ) public onlyRole(OPERATOR_ROLE) returns (bool result) {\n    _mint(receiver, id, amount);\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Burns tokens from a sender (only callable by OPERATOR_ROLE)\n  /// @param sender The sender address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param amount The amount to burn\n  /// @return result True if successful\n  function burn(\n    address sender,\n    uint256 id,\n    uint256 amount\n  ) public onlyRole(OPERATOR_ROLE) returns (bool result) {\n    _burn(sender, id, amount);\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Sets token metadata (only callable by EDITOR_ROLE)\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param metadata The token metadata\n  function setTokenMetadata(\n    uint256 id,\n    TokenMetadata calldata metadata\n  ) public onlyRole(EDITOR_ROLE) {\n    tokenMetadata[id] = metadata;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Returns the name of a token\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @return The token name\n  function name(uint256 id) public view returns (string memory) {\n    return tokenMetadata[id].name;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Returns the symbol of a token\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @return The token symbol\n  function symbol(uint256 id) public view returns (string memory) {\n    return tokenMetadata[id].symbol;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Returns the decimals of a token\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @return The token decimals\n  function decimals(uint256 id) public view returns (uint8) {\n    if (tokenMetadata[id].decimals == 0) {\n      return 18;\n    }\n    return tokenMetadata[id].decimals;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Sets the contract URI (only callable by EDITOR_ROLE)\n  /// @param uri The contract URI\n  function setContractURI(string calldata uri) public onlyRole(EDITOR_ROLE) {\n    contractURI = uri;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Returns the token URI\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @return The token URI\n  function tokenURI(uint256 id) public view returns (string memory) {\n    return string.concat(contractURI, \"/\", id.toString());\n  }\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                              ERC165 LOGIC\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Returns the domain separator for EIP712\n  /// @return The domain separator\n  function DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() external view returns (bytes32) {\n    return _domainSeparatorV4();\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Checks if the contract supports an interface\n  /// @param interfaceId The interface ID to check\n  /// @return result True if the interface is supported\n  function supportsInterface(\n    bytes4 interfaceId\n  ) public pure override(AccessControl) returns (bool result) {\n    return\n      interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7 || // ERC165 Interface ID for ERC165\n      interfaceId == 0x0f632fb3; // ERC165 Interface ID for ERC6909\n  }\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                        INTERNAL MINT/BURN LOGIC\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Internal function to mint tokens\n  /// @param receiver The recipient address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param amount The amount to mint\n  function _mint(address receiver, uint256 id, uint256 amount) internal {\n    balanceOf[receiver][id] += amount;\n    if (totalSupply[id] == 0) {\n      _createERC20View(id);\n    }\n    totalSupply[id] += amount;\n\n    emit Transfer(msg.sender, address(0), receiver, id, amount);\n    _emitERC20ViewEvent(id, address(0), receiver, amount);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Internal function to burn tokens\n  /// @param sender The sender address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param amount The amount to burn\n  function _burn(address sender, uint256 id, uint256 amount) internal {\n    balanceOf[sender][id] -= amount;\n    totalSupply[id] -= amount;\n\n    emit Transfer(msg.sender, sender, address(0), id, amount);\n    _emitERC20ViewEvent(id, sender, address(0), amount);\n  }\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                            INTERNAL HELPERS\n  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Internal function to emit ERC20View events\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param from The sender address\n  /// @param to The recipient address\n  /// @param amount The amount transferred\n  function _emitERC20ViewEvent(\n    uint256 id,\n    address from,\n    address to,\n    uint256 amount\n  ) internal {\n    address erc20ViewAddress = erc20Views[id];\n    if (msg.sender != erc20ViewAddress) {\n      IERC20View(erc20ViewAddress).emitTransferEvent(from, to, amount);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Internal function to emit ERC20View approval events\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param owner The owner address\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @param amount The approved amount\n  function _emitERC20ViewApprovalEvent(\n    uint256 id,\n    address owner,\n    address spender,\n    uint256 amount\n  ) internal {\n    address erc20ViewAddress = erc20Views[id];\n    if (msg.sender != erc20ViewAddress) {\n      IERC20View(erc20ViewAddress).emitApprovalEvent(owner, spender, amount);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Internal function to create an ERC20View contract\n  /// @param tokenId The token ID\n  /// @return The address of the created ERC20View contract\n  function _createERC20View(uint256 tokenId) internal returns (address) {\n    if (erc20Views[tokenId] != address(0)) {\n      return erc20Views[tokenId];\n    }\n\n    ERC20View erc20View = new ERC20View(tokenId);\n\n    address erc20ViewAddress = address(erc20View);\n    erc20Views[tokenId] = erc20ViewAddress;\n\n    emit ERC20ViewCreated(tokenId, erc20ViewAddress);\n    return erc20ViewAddress;\n  }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x38accdfaa5e7a7879ca20b650ae33a1ef4c6bd2c78254c4d6615cdfb0fdcce09","license":"MIT"},"contracts/Utils.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.28;\n\nimport {Strings} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Strings.sol\";\nimport {JSONParserLib} from \"solady/src/utils/JSONParserLib.sol\";\n\n/// @title Utils Library\n/// @author Relay Protocol\n/// @notice A utility library providing helper functions for cross-chain operations\n/// @dev Contains functions for token ID generation, address generation, and data encoding\nlibrary Utils {\n  /// @notice Generates a unique token ID based on blockchain family, chain ID, and token identifier\n  /// @param family The blockchain family ('bitcoin-vm', 'ethereum-vm', 'solana-vm', 'sui-vm')\n  /// @param chainId The ID of the blockchain network\n  /// @param token The token address or identifier as a string\n  /// @dev For EVM chains, the token string is parsed as an address. For non-EVM chains,\n  /// the token string is used directly as an identifier.\n  /// @return tokenId The token ID\n  function generateTokenId(\n    string memory family,\n    uint256 chainId,\n    string memory token\n  ) external pure returns (uint256 tokenId) {\n    if (Strings.equal(family, \"ethereum-vm\")) {\n      return\n        uint256(\n          keccak256(\n            abi.encodePacked(family, chainId, Strings.parseAddress(token))\n          )\n        );\n    }\n    return uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(family, chainId, token)));\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Generates a virtual address for a given blockchain family, chain ID, and account\n  /// @param family The blockchain family ('bitcoin-vm', 'ethereum-vm', 'solana-vm', 'sui-vm')\n  /// @param chainId The ID of the blockchain network\n  /// @param account The account address or identifier as a string\n  /// @dev For EVM chains, the account string is parsed as an address. For non-EVM chains,\n  /// the account string is used directly as an identifier.\n  /// @return virtualAddress A virtual address derived from the input parameters\n  function generateAddress(\n    string memory family,\n    uint256 chainId,\n    string memory account\n  ) external pure returns (address virtualAddress) {\n    bytes32 addressHash = Strings.equal(family, \"ethereum-vm\")\n      ? keccak256(\n        abi.encodePacked(family, chainId, Strings.parseAddress(account))\n      )\n      : keccak256(abi.encodePacked(family, chainId, account));\n\n    return address(uint160(uint256(addressHash)));\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Converts a uint64 value to a byte array in little-endian format\n  /// @param value The uint64 value to convert\n  /// @dev Each byte of the output represents 8 bits of the input value, starting from the least significant bits.\n  /// The result is a 8-byte array where the least significant byte comes first.\n  /// @return encodedBytes A byte array representing the value in little-endian format\n  function encodeUint64LE(\n    uint64 value\n  ) internal pure returns (bytes memory encodedBytes) {\n    bytes memory b = new bytes(8);\n    for (uint8 i = 0; i < 8; i++) {\n      b[i] = bytes1(uint8(value >> (8 * i)));\n    }\n    return b;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Converts a uint32 value to a byte array in little-endian format\n  /// @param value The uint32 value to convert\n  /// @dev Each byte of the output represents 8 bits of the input value, starting from the least significant bits.\n  /// The result is a 4-byte array where the least significant byte comes first.\n  /// @return encodedBytes A byte array representing the value in little-endian format\n  function encodeUint32LE(\n    uint32 value\n  ) internal pure returns (bytes memory encodedBytes) {\n    bytes memory b = new bytes(4);\n    for (uint8 i = 0; i < 4; i++) {\n      b[i] = bytes1(uint8(value >> (8 * i)));\n    }\n    return b;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Converts a hex string to bytes32\n  /// @param s The hex string to convert (with or without '0x' prefix)\n  /// @dev Accepts strings of exactly 64 hex characters or 66 characters with \"0x\" prefix.\n It is used to charge the user\n  /// required tokens for paying NEAR storage fees and attached balance\n  /// for cross contract calls.\n  IERC20 wNEAR;\n}\n\nlibrary AuroraSdk {\n  using Codec for bytes;\n  using Codec for PromiseCreateArgs;\n  using Codec for PromiseWithCallback;\n  using Codec for Borsh.Data;\n  using Borsh for Borsh.Data;\n\n  /// Create an instance of NEAR object. Requires the address at which\n  /// wNEAR ERC20 token contract is deployed.\n  function initNear(IERC20 wNEAR) public returns (NEAR memory) {\n    NEAR memory near = NEAR(wNEAR);\n    near.wNEAR.approve(\n      XCC_PRECOMPILE,\n      0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff\n    );\n    return near;\n  }\n\n  /// Default configuration for mainnet.\n  function mainnet() public returns (NEAR memory) {\n    return initNear(IERC20(wNEAR_MAINNET));\n  }\n\n  /// Compute NEAR represtentative account for the given Aurora address.\n  /// This is the NEAR account created by the cross contract call precompile.\n  function nearRepresentative(address account) public returns (string memory) {\n    return addressSubAccount(account, currentAccountId());\n  }\n\n  /// Prepends the given account ID with the given address (hex-encoded).\n  function addressSubAccount(\n    address account,\n    string memory accountId\n  ) public pure returns (string memory) {\n    return\n      string(\n        abi.encodePacked(\n          AuroraXccUtils.bytesToHex(abi.encodePacked((bytes20(account)))),\n          \".\",\n          accountId\n        )\n      );\n  }\n\n  /// Compute implicity Aurora Address for the given NEAR account.\n  function implicitAuroraAddress(\n    string memory accountId\n  ) public pure returns (address) {\n    return address(uint160(uint256(keccak256(bytes(accountId)))));\n  }\n\n  /// Compute the implicit Aurora address of the represenative NEAR account\n  /// for the given Aurora address. Useful when a contract wants to call\n  /// itself via a callback using cross contract call precompile.\n  function nearRepresentitiveImplicitAddress(\n    address account\n  ) public returns (address) {\n    return implicitAuroraAddress(nearRepresentative(account));\n  }\n\n  /// Get the promise result at the specified index.\n  function promiseResult(\n    uint256 index\n  ) public returns (PromiseResult memory result) {\n    (bool success, bytes memory returnData) = PROMISE_RESULT_PRECOMPILE.call(\n      \"\"\n    );\n    require(success);\n\n    Borsh.Data memory borsh = Borsh.from(returnData);\n\n    uint32 length = borsh.decodeU32();\n    require(index < length, \"Index out of bounds\");\n\n    for (uint256 i = 0; i < index; i++) {\n      PromiseResultStatus status = PromiseResultStatus(uint8(borsh.decodeU8()));\n      if (status == PromiseResultStatus.Successful) {\n        borsh.skipBytes();\n      }\n    }\n\n    result.status = PromiseResultStatus(borsh.decodeU8());\n    if (result.status == PromiseResultStatus.Successful) {\n      result.output = borsh.decodeBytes();\n    }\n  }\n\n  /// Get the NEAR account id of the current contract. This is not immediately scheduled for execution\n  /// until transact is called. If it is invalid, the\n  /// transaction will be scheduled either way, but it will fail during execution.\n  function call(\n    NEAR storage,\n    string memory targetAccountId,\n    string memory method,\n    bytes memory args,\n    uint128 nearBalance,\n    uint64 nearGas\n  ) public pure returns (PromiseCreateArgs memory) {\n    return\n      PromiseCreateArgs(targetAccountId, method, args, nearBalance, nearGas);\n  }\n\n  /// Similar to `call`. It is a wrapper that simplifies the creation of a promise\n  /// to a contract inside `Aurora`.\n  function auroraCall(\n    NEAR storage,\n    address target,\n    bytes memory args,\n    uint128 nearBalance,\n    uint64 nearGas\n  ) public returns (PromiseCreateArgs memory) {\n    return\n      PromiseCreateArgs(\n        currentAccountId(),\n        \"call\",\n        abi.encodePacked(uint8(0), target, uint256(0), args.encode()),\n        nearBalance,\n        nearGas\n      );\n  }\n\n  /// Schedule a base promise to be executed on NEAR. After this function is called\n  /// the promise should not be used anymore (i.e. should not be used with any further combinators).\n  /// The promise also cannot be used to obtain any result of the call. A result can only be used\n  /// by attaching a callback using `then` prior to calling `transact`.\n  function transact(PromiseCreateArgs memory nearPromise) public {\n    (bool success, bytes memory returnData) = XCC_PRECOMPILE.call(\n      nearPromise.encodeCrossContractCallArgs(ExecutionMode.Eager)\n    );\n\n    if (!success) {\n      revert(string(returnData));\n    }\n  }\n\n  /// Schedule a promise with callback to be executed on NEAR. Check relevant issue:\n  /// https://github.com/ethereum/solidity/issues/869\n  function transact(PromiseWithCallback memory nearPromise) public {\n    (bool success, bytes memory returnData) = XCC_PRECOMPILE.call(\n      nearPromise.encodeCrossContractCallArgs(ExecutionMode.Eager)\n    );\n\n    if (!success) {\n      revert(string(returnData));\n    }\n  }\n\n  /// Similar to `transact`, except the promise is not executed as part of the same transaction.\n  /// A separate transaction to execute the scheduled promise is needed.\n  function lazy_transact(PromiseCreateArgs memory nearPromise) public {\n    (bool success, bytes memory returnData) = XCC_PRECOMPILE.call(\n      nearPromise.encodeCrossContractCallArgs(ExecutionMode.Lazy)\n    );\n\n    if (!success) {\n      revert(string(returnData));\n    }\n  }\n\n  function lazy_transact(PromiseWithCallback memory nearPromise) public {\n    (bool success, bytes memory returnData) = XCC_PRECOMPILE.call(\n      nearPromise.encodeCrossContractCallArgs(ExecutionMode.Lazy)\n    );\n\n    if (!success) {\n      revert(string(returnData));\n    }\n  }\n\n  /// Create a promise with callback from two given promises.\n  function then(\n    PromiseCreateArgs memory base,\n    PromiseCreateArgs memory callback\n  ) public pure returns (PromiseWithCallback memory) {\n    return PromiseWithCallback(base, function swapBytes4(uint32 v) internal pure returns (uint32) {\n    v = ((v & 0x00ff00ff) << 8) | ((v & 0xff00ff00) >> 8);\n    return (v << 16) | (v >> 16);\n  }\n\n  function swapBytes8(uint64 v) }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xc453297d8c75e23d71193c985908f1cc0a0c425ae8b3e97da7022e3604b5f94f","license":"CC-BY-1.0"},"contracts/aurora-xcc/Borsh.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-1.0\npragma solidity ^0.8.17;\n\nimport \"./AuroraXccUtils.sol\";\n\nlibrary Borsh {\n  using Borsh for Data;\n\n  struct Data {\n    uint256 ptr;\n    uint256 end;\n  }\n\n  function from(bytes memory data) internal pure returns (Data memory res) {\n    uint256 ptr;\n    assembly {\n      ptr := data\n    }\n    unchecked {\n      res.ptr = ptr + 32;\n      res.end = res.ptr + In the current code, length is always less than 2^32.\n  function requireSpace(Data memory data, uint256 length) internal pure {\n    unchecked {\n      require(data.ptr + length <= data.end, \"Parse error: unexpected EOI\");\n    }\n  }\n\n  function read(\n    Data memory data,\n    uint256 length\n  ) internal pure returns (bytes32 res) {\n    data.requireSpace(length);\n    res = (bytes32) {\n    data.requireSpace(length);\n    return AuroraXccUtils.keccak256Raw(data.ptr, length);\n  }\n\n  // Same considerations as for requireSpace.\n  function peekSha256(\n    Data memory internal pure returns (uint8) {\n    return uint8(bytes1(data.read(1)));\n  }\n\n  function decodeU16(Data memory data) internal pure returns (uint16) {\n    return CC-BY-1.0\npragma solidity ^0.8.17;\n\nimport \"./Borsh.sol\";\nimport \"./Types.sol\";\nimport \"./AuroraXccUtils.sol\";\n\n/// Provide borsh serialization and deserialization for multiple types.\nlibrary Codec {\n  using Borsh for Borsh.Data;\n\n  function encodeU8(uint8 v) internal pure returns (bytes1) {\n    return bytes1(v);\n  }\n\n  function encodeU16(uint16 v) internal pure returns (bytes2) {\n    return bytes2(AuroraXccUtils.swapBytes2(v));\n  }\n\n  function encodeU32(uint32 v) public pure returns (bytes4) {\n    return bytes4(AuroraXccUtils.swapBytes4(v));\n  }\n\n  function encodeU64(uint64 v) public pure returns (bytes8) {\n    return bytes8(AuroraXccUtils.swapBytes8(v));\n  }\n\n  function encodeU128(uint128 v) public pure returns (bytes16) {\n    return bytes16(AuroraXccUtils.swapBytes16(v));\n  }\n\n  /// Encode bytes into borsh. Use this method to encode strings as well.\n  function encode(bytes memory value) public pure returns (bytes memory) {\n    return abi.encodePacked(encodeU32(uint32(value.length)), bytes(value));\n  }\n\n  /// Encode Execution mode enum into borsh.\n  function encode(ExecutionMode mode) public pure returns (bytes1) {\n    return bytes1(uint8(mode));\n  }\n\n  /// Encode PromiseArgsVariant enum into borsh.\n  function encode(PromiseArgsVariant mode) public pure returns (bytes1) {\n    return bytes1(uint8(mode));\n  }\n\n  /// Encode base promise into borsh.\n  function encode(\n    PromiseCreateArgs memory nearPromise\n  ) public pure returns (bytes memory) {\n    return\n      abi.encodePacked(\n        encode(bytes(nearPromise.targetAccountId)),\n        encode(bytes(nearPromise.method)),\n        encode(nearPromise.args),\n        encodeU128(nearPromise.nearBalance),\n        encodeU64(nearPromise.nearGas)\n      );\n  }\n\n  /// Encode promise with callback into borsh.\n  function encode(\n    PromiseWithCallback memory nearPromise\n  ) public pure returns (bytes memory) {\n    return\n      abi.encodePacked(encode(nearPromise.base), encode(nearPromise.callback));\n  }\n\n  /// Encode create promise using borsh. The encoded data\n  /// uses the same format that the Cross Contract Call precompile expects.\n  function encodeCrossContractCallArgs(\n    PromiseCreateArgs memory nearPromise,\n    ExecutionMode mode\n  ) public pure returns (bytes memory) {\n    return\n      abi.encodePacked(\n        encode(mode),\n        encode(PromiseArgsVariant.Create),\n        encode(nearPromise)\n      );\n  }\n\n  /// Encode promise with callback using borsh. The encoded data\n  /// uses the same format that the Cross Contract Call precompile expects.\n  function encodeCrossContractCallArgs(\n    PromiseWithCallback memory nearPromise,\n    ExecutionMode mode\n  ) public pure returns (bytes memory) {\n    return\n      abi.encodePacked(\n        encode(mode),\n        encode(PromiseArgsVariant.Callback),\n        encode(nearPromise)\n      );\n  }\n\n  /// Decode promise result using borsh.\n  function decodePromiseResult(\n    Borsh.Data memory data\n  ) public pure returns (PromiseResult memory result) {\n    result.status = PromiseResultStatus(data.decodeU8());\n    if (result.status == PromiseResultStatus.Successful) {\n      result.output = data.decodeBytes();\n    }\n  }\n\n  /// Skip promise result from the buffer.\n  function skipPromiseResult(Borsh.Data memory data) public pure {\n    PromiseResultStatus status = PromiseResultStatus(uint8(data.decodeU8()));\n    if (status == PromiseResultStatus.Successful) {\n      data.skipBytes();\n    }\n  }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xebc00ae2f8aafd338b483af48ed14cacd41623bc1b4cada3f64bcf8e6806913d","license":"CC-BY-1.0"},"contracts/aurora-xcc/Types.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-1.0\npragma solidity ^0.8.17;\n\n/// Basic NEAR promise.\nstruct PromiseCreateArgs {\n  /// Account id of the target contract to be called.\n  string targetAccountId;\n  /// Method in the contract to be called\n  string method;\n  /// Payload to be passed to the method as input.\n  bytes args;\n  /// Amount of NEAR tokens to attach to the call. This will\n  /// be charged from the caller in wNEAR.\n  uint128 nearBalance;\n  /// Amount of gas to attach to the call.\n  uint64 nearGas;\n}\n\nenum PromiseArgsVariant {\n  /// Basic NEAR promise\n\n  Create,\n  /// NEAR promise with a callback attached.\n  Callback,\n  /// Description of arbitrary NEAR promise. Allows applying combinators\n  /// recursively, multiple action types and batched actions.\n  /// See https://nomicon.io/RuntimeSpec/Components/BindingsSpec/PromisesAPI\n  /// for a complete description of what is possible.\n  Recursive\n}\n\n/// Combine two base promises using NEAR combinator `then`.\nstruct PromiseWithCallback {\n  /// Initial promise to be triggered.\n  PromiseCreateArgs base;\n  /// Second promise that is executed after the execution of `base`.\n  /// In particular this promise will have access to the result of\n  /// the `base` promise.\n  PromiseCreateArgs callback;\n}\n\nenum ExecutionMode {\n  /// Eager mode means that the promise WILL be executed in a single\n  /// NEAR transaction.\n\n  Eager,\n  /// Lazy mode means that the promise WILL be scheduled for execution\n  /// and a separate interaction is required to trigger this execution.\n  Lazy\n}\n\nenum PromiseResultStatus {\n  /// This status should not be reachable.\n\n  NotReady,\n  /// The promise was executed successfully.\n  Successful,\n  /// The promise execution failed.\n  Failed\n}\n\nstruct PromiseResult {\n  /// Status result of the promise execution.\n  PromiseResultStatus status;\n  /// If the status is successful, output contains the output of the promise.\n  /// Otherwise the output field MUST be ignored.\n  bytes output;\n}\n","keccak256":"0xbb2687a01410997020e20506d247381d95e8f7d015fb771bf4ca83e01291fd27","license":"CC-BY-1.0"},"solady/src/utils/JSONParserLib.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier:
