one address to another\n  /// @param sender The sender address\n  /// @param receiver The receiver address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param amount The amount to transfer\n  /// @return True if successful\n  function transferFrom(\n    address sender,\n    address receiver,\n    uint256 id,\n    uint256 amount\n  ) external returns (bool);\n\n  /// @notice Returns the total supply of a token\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @return The total supply\n  function totalSupply(uint256 id) external view returns (uint256);\n\n  /// @notice Returns the name of a token\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @return The token name\n  function name(uint256 id) external view returns (string memory);\n\n  /// @notice Returns the symbol of a token\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @return The token symbol\n  function symbol(uint256 id) external view returns (string memory);\n\n  /// @notice Returns the decimals of a token\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @return The token decimals\n  function decimals(uint256 id) external view returns (uint8);\n\n  /// @notice Returns the token URI of a token\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @return The token URI\n  function tokenURI(uint256 id) external view returns (string memory);\n\n  /// @notice Returns the allowance of a spender for an owner\n  /// @param owner The owner address\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @return The allowance amount\n  function allowance(\n    address owner,\n    address spender,\n    uint256 id\n  ) external view returns (uint256);\n\n  /// @notice Approves a spender to spend tokens on behalf of owner\n  /// @param owner The owner address\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param amount The amount to approve\n  /// @return True if successful\n  function approveFor(\n    address owner,\n    address spender,\n    uint256 id,\n    uint256 amount\n  ) external returns (bool);\n}\n\n/// @title ERC20View\n/// @author Relay Protocol\n/// @notice ERC20-compatible view contract that interfaces with the Hub\ncontract ERC20View {\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                EVENTS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Emitted when an approval is made\n  event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);\n  /// @notice Emitted when a transfer occurs\n  event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                            CUSTOM ERRORS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  error ERC20ViewInsufficientAllowance(\n    address spender,\n    uint256 allowance,\n    uint256 needed\n  );\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                STORAGE\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice The Hub contract instance\n  IHub public immutable hub;\n  /// @notice The token ID this view represents\n  uint256 public immutable tokenId;\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                              CONSTRUCTOR\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Constructor for ERC20View\n  /// @param _tokenId The token ID this view represents\n  constructor(uint256 _tokenId) {\n    hub = IHub(msg.sender);\n    tokenId = _tokenId;\n  }\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                          ERC20 IMPLEMENTATION\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Returns the name of the token\n  /// @return The token name\n  function name() public view returns (string memory) {\n    return hub.name(tokenId);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Returns the symbol of the token\n  /// @return The token symbol\n  function symbol() public view returns (string memory) {\n    return hub.symbol(tokenId);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Returns the decimals of the token\n  /// @return The token decimals\n  function decimals() public view returns (uint8) {\n    return hub.decimals(tokenId);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Returns the token URI\n  /// @return The token URI\n  function tokenURI() public view returns (string memory) {\n    return hub.tokenURI(tokenId);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Returns the total supply of the token\n  /// @return The total supply\n  function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) {\n    return hub.totalSupply(tokenId);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Returns the balance of an account\n  /// @param account The account address\n  /// @return The balance amount\n  function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {\n    return hub.balanceOf(account, tokenId);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Returns the allowance amount for a spender\n  /// @param owner The owner address\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @return The allowance amount\n  function allowance(\n    address owner,\n    address spender\n  ) public view returns (uint256) {\n    return hub.allowance(owner, spender, tokenId);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Approves a spender to spend tokens\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @param value The amount to approve\n  /// @return True if successful\n  function approve(address spender, uint256 value) public returns (bool) {\n    bool success = hub.approveFor(msg.sender, spender, tokenId, value);\n    if (success) {\n      emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, value);\n    }\n    return success;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Transfers tokens to another address\n  /// @param to The recipient address\n  /// @param value The amount to transfer\n  /// @return True if successful\n  function transfer(address to, uint256 value) public returns (bool) {\n    bool success = hub.transferFrom(msg.sender, to, tokenId, value);\n    if (success) {\n      emit Transfer(msg.sender, to, value);\n    }\n    return success;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Transfers tokens from one address to another\n  /// @param from The sender address\n  /// @param to The recipient address\n  /// @param value The amount to transfer\n  /// @return True if successful\n  function transferFrom(\n    address from,\n    address to,\n    uint256 value\n  ) public returns (bool) {\n    // Check allowance unless the spender is the owner\n    if (msg.sender != from) {\n      uint256 currentAllowance = hub.allowance(from, msg.sender, tokenId);\n      if (currentAllowance < type(uint256).max) {\n        if (currentAllowance < value) {\n          revert ERC20ViewInsufficientAllowance(\n            msg.sender,\n            currentAllowance,\n            value\n          );\n        }\n        hub.approveFor(from, msg.sender, tokenId, currentAllowance - value);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Execute the transfer on the Hub\n    bool success = hub.transferFrom(from, to, tokenId, value);\n    if (success) {\n      emit Transfer(from, to, value);\n    }\n    return success;\n  }\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                          HUB EVENT EMISSION\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Emits a transfer event (only callable by the hub)\n  /// @param from The sender address\n  /// @param to The recipient address\n  /// @param value The amount transferred\n  function emitTransferEvent(address from, address to, uint256 value) external {\n    if (msg.sender == address(hub)) {\n      emit Transfer(from, to, value);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Emits an approval event (only callable by the hub)\n  /// @param owner The owner address\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @param value The approved amount\n  function emitApprovalEvent(\n    address owner,\n    address spender,\n    uint256 value\n  ) external {\n    if (msg.sender == address(hub)) {\n      emit Approval(owner, spender, value);\n    }\n  }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xb7b82f3d5501154c68526fddbb556effc42f04e9c932d94040222a0680326fba","license":"MIT"},"contracts/RelayHub.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity \"./ERC20View.sol\";\n\n/// @title IERC20View\n/// @author Relay Protocol\n/// @notice Interface for ERC20View contract\ninterface IERC20View {\n  /// @notice Emits a transfer event\n  /// @param from The sender address\n  /// @param to The recipient address\n  /// @param value The amount transferred\n  function emitTransferEvent(address from, address to, uint256 value) external;\n\n  /// @notice Emits an approval event\n  /// @param owner The owner address\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @param value The approved amount\n  function emitApprovalEvent(\n    address owner,\n    address spender,\n    uint256 value\n  ) external;\n}\n\n/// @title RelayHub\n/// @author Relay Protocol\n/// @notice Based on Solmate standard ERC6909 implementation. (https://github.com/transmissions11/solmate/blob/main/src/tokens/ERC6909.sol)\ncontract RelayHub is AccessControl, EIP712 {\n  using Strings for uint256;\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                            CUSTOM ERRORS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Error thrown when non-ERC20View tries to call approveFor\n  /// @param caller The address that attempted to call approveFor\n  /// @param expectedERC20View The expected ERC20View address for the token\n  error OnlyERC20ViewCanCallApproveFor(\n    address caller,\n    address expectedERC20View\n  );\n\n  /// @notice Error thrown when permit deadline has expired\n  error PermitDeadlineExpired();\n\n  /// @notice Error thrown when permit signature is invalid\n  error InvalidPermitSignature();\n\n  /// @notice Error thrown when permit owner is the zero address\n  error InvalidPermitOwner();\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                 EVENTS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Emitted when an operator is set for an owner\n  event OperatorSet(\n    address indexed owner,\n    address indexed operator,\n    bool approved\n  );\n\n  /// @notice Emitted when an approval is made\n  event Approval(\n    address indexed owner,\n    address indexed spender,\n    uint256 indexed id,\n    uint256 amount\n  );\n\n  /// @notice Emitted when a transfer occurs\n  event Transfer(\n    address caller,\n    address indexed from,\n    address indexed to,\n    uint256 indexed id,\n    uint256 amount\n  );\n\n  struct TokenMetadata {\n    string name;\n    string symbol;\n    uint8 decimals;\n    string originFamily;\n    uint256 originChainId;\n    string originAsset;\n  }\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                             ERC6909 STORAGE\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) internal _isOperator;\n\n  /// @notice Mapping of owner to token ID to balance\n  mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) public balanceOf;\n\n  /// @notice Mapping of owner to spender to token ID to allowance\n  mapping(address => mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256)))\n    public allowance;\n\n  /// @notice Mapping of token ID to total supply\n  mapping(uint256 => uint256) public totalSupply;\n\n  /// @notice Mapping of owner to nonce for permit signatures\n  mapping(address => uint256) public nonces;\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                          ERC20VIEW STORAGE\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  // tokenId => ERC20View address\n  /// @notice Mapping of token ID to ERC20View contract address\n  mapping(uint256 => address) public erc20Views;\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                        ERC20VIEW EVENTS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Emitted when an ERC20View is created\n  event ERC20ViewCreated(uint256 indexed tokenId, address indexed erc20View);\n  /// @notice Mapping of token ID to token metadata\n  mapping(uint256 => TokenMetadata) public tokenMetadata;\n\n  /// @notice Contract URI for metadata\n  string public contractURI = \"\";\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                             ROLES\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Role for operators\n  bytes32 public constant OPERATOR_ROLE = keccak256(\"OPERATOR_ROLE\");\n  /// @notice Role for editors\n  bytes32 public constant EDITOR_ROLE = keccak256(\"EDITOR_ROLE\");\n  /// @notice Role for administrators\n  bytes32 public constant ADMIN_ROLE = keccak256(\"ADMIN_ROLE\");\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                          EIP712 CONSTANTS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice EIP712 typehash for permit\n  bytes32 public constant PERMIT_TYPEHASH =\n    keccak256(\n      \"Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 tokenId,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)\"\n    );\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                             CONSTRUCTOR\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Constructor for RelayHub contract\n  /// @param adminAddress The address to grant admin role\n  constructor(address adminAddress) EIP712(\"RelayHub\", \"1\") {\n    _setRoleAdmin(OPERATOR_ROLE, ADMIN_ROLE);\n    _setRoleAdmin(EDITOR_ROLE, ADMIN_ROLE);\n    _setRoleAdmin(ADMIN_ROLE, ADMIN_ROLE);\n    _grantRole(ADMIN_ROLE, adminAddress);\n  }\n\n  /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                              ERC6909 LOGIC\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n  /// @notice Checks if an address is an operator for an account\n  /// @param account The account address\n  /// @param operator The operator address\n  /// @return True if the operator is authorized\n  function isOperator(\n    address account,\n    address operator\n  ) public view returns (bool) {\n    return hasRole(OPERATOR_ROLE, operator) || _isOperator[account][operator];\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Internal function to set an operator for an account\n  /// @param account The account address\n  /// @param operator The operator address\n  /// @param approved Whether to approve the operator\n  /// @return result True if successful\n  function _setOperatorFor(\n    address account,\n    address operator,\n    bool approved\n  ) internal returns (bool result) {\n    _isOperator[account][operator] = approved;\n    emit OperatorSet(account, operator, approved);\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Sets an operator for an account (only callable by OPERATOR_ROLE)\n  /// @param account The account address\n  /// @param operator The operator address\n  /// @param approved Whether to approve the operator\n  /// @return result True if successful\n  function setOperatorFor(\n    address account,\n    address operator,\n    bool approved\n  ) public onlyRole(OPERATOR_ROLE) returns (bool result) {\n    return _setOperatorFor(account, operator, approved);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Sets an operator for the caller\n  /// @param operator The operator address\n  /// @param approved Whether to approve the operator\n  /// @return result True if successful\n  function setOperator(\n    address operator,\n    bool approved\n  ) public returns (bool result) {\n    return _setOperatorFor(msg.sender, operator, approved);\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Transfers tokens to another address\n  /// @param receiver The recipient address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param amount The amount to transfer\n  /// @return result True if successful\n  function transfer(\n    address receiver,\n    uint256 id,\n    uint256 amount\n  ) public returns (bool result) {\n    balanceOf[msg.sender][id] -= amount;\n\n    balanceOf[receiver][id] += amount;\n\n    emit Transfer(msg.sender, msg.sender, receiver, id, amount);\n    _emitERC20ViewEvent(id, msg.sender, receiver, amount);\n\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Transfers tokens from one address to another\n  /// @param sender The sender address\n  /// @param receiver The recipient address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param amount The amount to transfer\n  /// @return result True if successful\n  function transferFrom(\n    address sender,\n    address receiver,\n    uint256 id,\n    uint256 amount\n  ) public returns (bool result) {\n    if (\n      msg.sender != sender &&\n      !isOperator(sender, msg.sender) &&\n      erc20Views[id] != msg.sender\n    ) {\n      uint256 allowed = allowance[sender][msg.sender][id];\n      if (allowed != type(uint256).max)\n        allowance[sender][msg.sender][id] = allowed - amount;\n    }\n\n    balanceOf[sender][id] -= amount;\n\n    balanceOf[receiver][id] += amount;\n\n    emit Transfer(msg.sender, sender, receiver, id, amount);\n    _emitERC20ViewEvent(id, sender, receiver, amount);\n\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Approves a spender to spend tokens\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param amount The amount to approve\n  /// @return result True if successful\n  function approve(\n    address spender,\n    uint256 id,\n    uint256 amount\n  ) public returns (bool result) {\n    allowance[msg.sender][spender][id] = amount;\n\n    emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, id, amount);\n    _emitERC20ViewApprovalEvent(id, msg.sender, spender, amount);\n\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  /// @notice Approves a spender to spend tokens on behalf of owner (only callable by ERC20View)\n  /// @param owner The owner address\n  /// @param spender The spender address\n  /// @param id The token ID\n  /// @param amount The amount to approve\n  /// @return result True if successful\n  function approveFor(\n    address owner,\n    address spender,\n    uint256 id,\n    uint256 amount\n  ) public returns (bool result) {\n    if (erc20Views[id] != msg.sender) {\n      revert OnlyERC20ViewCanCallApproveFor(msg.sender, erc20Views[id]);\n    }\n\n    allowance[owner][spender][id] = amount;\n\n    emit Approval(owner, spender, id, amount);\n    // Note: The ERC20View
